Three tables carry a thread [6][11].

```mermaid
erDiagram
  THREAD ||--o{ MESSAGE : holds
  MESSAGE ||--o{ CITATION : cites
  THREAD ||--o| SHARE : "is shared as"
  THREAD {
    int id
    string title
  }
  MESSAGE {
    int ordinal
    string answer
  }
```

A share points at the thread, not at a message [11].
